verdict.rationale: Databricks Free Edition is documented as a no-cost workspace for exploring datasets, running notebooks, and using AI/ML tools, replacing the old Community Edition, and a separate free trial account is also offered — both let an analyst run real queries on real data without a sales call. However, the evidence never explicitly states no credit card is required for either the trial or Free Edition. Missing for 10: explicit no-credit-card confirmation, and independent/hands-on corroboration of the actual sign-up flow.
